[Act: consumer
 Chapter: Cenral Consumer Protection Authority
 Section: 23::Designation of any statutory authority or body to function as Central Authority.
]


The Central Government may, if it considers necessary, by notification, designate any statutory authority or body to exercise the powers and perform the functions of the Central Authority referred to in section 10.

metadata.section_title: Designation of any statutory authority or body to function as Central Authority.
